about: Hand-kept additions to Data/Spots.lua, read by tools/gen_spots.py. Nothing here comes from a data file.
quests[skill][A|H]: who starts the class quest; the generator finds the NPC's position by name.
zoneOf[target key] = uiMap: a border the map data gets wrong.
spots[spot id] = { area, note, indoor }: keyed by the ids the generator writes; an id it no longer writes is an error.
manual[skill] = [ spot, ... ]: spots written out by hand (id, map, zone, x, y required), copied as they are.
